title: HTML Basics
intro: Learn the foundation of web pages using HTML elements, structure and basic coding concepts.
topic1_text: Learn what HTML is and how it creates the structure of web pages.
topic2_text: Learn common tags for headings, paragraphs, links, images and page sections.
topic3_text: Learn how to build a basic webpage using HTML structure.
topic4_text: Learn how to open and check your webpage in a browser.
practice: Create a simple personal profile webpage using HTML.
